Designating November 7 of each year as ''Shwachman Diamond Syndrome Awareness Day''.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

bill.summary: This resolution supports the designation of Shwachman Diamond Syndrome Awareness Day to increase awareness of the disease and promote further research into effective treatments.
